notes:
PhoneBridge 0.7.0 gives computer AI a clear way to share phones.

- Connect several phones to one computer, and keep several trusted computer connections on one phone. Device views show who is controlling and how many tasks are waiting.
- AI requests control before a task. Other tasks wait in order; releasing control notifies the next waiting AI immediately through the existing connection.
- Choose screen awake: off, during control, or always while PhoneBridge accessibility service runs. Manual screen lock still takes priority.
- Richer screen snapshots, element actions, page conditions and device-attributed operation history make computer agents easier to integrate and test.
- Saved pairing is retained. The fixed MCP launcher follows the installed desktop version, so its configured command does not change on upgrade. Restart an existing AI/MCP session after upgrading to load the new tools.

Install the Android APK directly. Upgrade each controlling computer to use the new queue tools. Windows installer/portable and macOS Apple Silicon/Intel packages are included.

Validated on one physical Android 16 phone with two independent installed MCP processes, including FIFO handoff notifications and all three screen-awake modes. Additional phones/connections are covered by automated tests. macOS packages pass CI build and lifecycle checks; physical Mac acceptance is separate. macOS apps are ad-hoc signed, not Apple notarized.
